Where can I find current Great Britain electricity generation by source, with observation timestamps and source evidence?

Finished

For current, timestamped Great Britain generation by fuel, the best primary source is Elexon’s BMRS “Generation” page. It reports actual aggregated net output in MW by production type and settlement period, so you can verify both the value and its observation/settlement timestamp.
bmrs.elexon.co

Primary source: Elexon BMRS

Where: 
Elexon BMRS — Generation

What it provides: Actual aggregated generation by fuel type for Great Britain, including wind and solar output, interconnector flows, and forecasts versus actuals.
bmrs.elexon.co

Timestamps: Data are organised by settlement period; the site’s “Generation By Fuel type” report gives actual net generation output per period and production type.
bmrs.elexon.co

Source evidence: Elexon is the UK’s electricity settlement system operator, and its BMRS is the underlying feed used by several live dashboards.
purelyenergy.co
+1

Use this when you need defensible, near-real-time figures rather than a pre-aggregated chart.

Convenient live dashboards
Site	What you get	Timestamp / evidence

Energy Dashboard — Live GB
	GB generation mix, demand, carbon intensity and price; updates every 5 minutes. 
energydashboard.co
	Shows the latest generation mix and half-hourly time series; its methodology/source page identifies underlying data sources. 
energydashboard.co


energy.org.uk — Live
	GB generation by source, imports, storage, demand and carbon; explicitly labels delayed observations. 
energy.org
	Displays an observation time (for example, “06:55 UK time”), status, coverage, and cites Elexon BMRS and NESO. 
energy.org


Purely Energy — Grid map
	Live fuel-by-fuel output and share, plus plant and interconnector context. 
purelyenergy.co
	States that data come from Elexon’s settlement feed, the NESO Data Portal, and the Carbon Intensity API. 
purelyenergy.co

For example, energy.org.uk’s live page reports its generation breakdown from Elexon BMRS’s five-minute FUELINST feed, shows the observation time, and marks the data as delayed when the latest valid observation is not current.
energy.org

Important scope caveat

Most live “UK” dashboards are actually showing Great Britain only, not Northern Ireland; energy.org.uk explicitly labels its coverage as Great Britain. If you need the whole UK, use DESNZ’s official Electricity statistics collection, which includes monthly and quarterly UK generation, fuel use, trade and consumption statistics.
gov
+2

Recommended workflow

Open Elexon BMRS Generation for the authoritative current GB output by fuel and settlement period.
bmrs.elexon.co

Cross-check the headline mix on Energy Dashboard or energy.org.uk, recording their displayed observation time and “delayed” status if present.
energy.org
+1

For official historical or UK-wide analysis, use GOV.UK Electricity statistics and Energy Trends; these are published with defined reporting lags rather than live timestamps.
gov
